dedup_rules_applied: Same investigational agent + same protocol/site/indication is one study even if found on developer, university, CRO and press-release pages.
Commercial/licensed access is a separate opportunity type from a clinical trial using the same product.
A successor protocol with a different protocol ID or materially different intervention is not automatically a duplicate.
Closed, fully enrolled, suspended or on-hold studies are never surfaced as active matching opportunities.
Pipeline announcements without a current owner enrollment route remain watchlist only.
Supportive care, diagnostics, biomarkers, prevention, sample collection and observational studies are rejected from treatment matching.
